Flu.name: Flu
Flu.description: Influenza, commonly known as the flu, is a contagious respiratory illness caused by influenza viruses. It can cause mild to severe symptoms and typically resolves within one to two weeks.
Flu.recommendation: Rest, stay hydrated, and consider over-the-counter medication for symptom relief. Seek medical attention if symptoms worsen or persist beyond a week.

Common Cold.name: Common Cold
Common Cold.description: The common cold is a mild viral infection of the upper respiratory tract. It is usually harmless and resolves on its own within a week or two.
Common Cold.recommendation: Rest, stay hydrated, and use over-the-counter remedies as needed. Consult a doctor if symptoms persist beyond ten days.

COVID-19.name: COVID-19
COVID-19.description: COVID-19 is a respiratory illness caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus. Symptoms range from mild to severe and may include loss of smell or taste, which is a distinguishing feature.
COVID-19.recommendation: Isolate to prevent spread, monitor symptoms, and take a COVID-19 test. Seek medical care if breathing becomes difficult.

Malaria.name: Malaria
Malaria.description: Malaria is a serious disease caused by a parasite transmitted through the bite of infected mosquitoes. It typically presents with cyclical fever, chills, and sweating.
Malaria.recommendation: Seek medical attention immediately. Malaria requires prompt diagnosis and antimalarial treatment to prevent complications.

Diabetes.name: Diabetes
Diabetes.description: Diabetes is a chronic condition that affects how the body processes blood sugar. Symptoms include excessive thirst, frequent urination, fatigue, and unexplained weight loss.
Diabetes.recommendation: Consult a healthcare provider for blood sugar testing. Long-term management includes diet, exercise, and possibly medication.

Migraine.name: Migraine
Migraine.description: A migraine is a neurological condition that often causes intense, throbbing headaches, frequently accompanied by nausea, vomiting, and sensitivity to light or sound.
Migraine.recommendation: Rest in a dark, quiet room and use prescribed medication if available. Consult a doctor if migraines are frequent or severe.

Food Poisoning.name: Food Poisoning
Food Poisoning.description: Food poisoning is an illness caused by eating contaminated food. Symptoms typically include vomiting, diarrhea, nausea, and sometimes fever, and usually develop within hours of eating.
Food Poisoning.recommendation: Stay hydrated and rest. Seek medical care if symptoms are severe, last more than two days, or include high fever or signs of dehydration.

Allergies.name: Allergies
Allergies.description: Allergies occur when the immune system reacts to substances such as pollen, dust, or pet dander. Symptoms often include sneezing, runny nose, and itchy or sore throat.
Allergies.recommendation: Avoid known allergens and consider antihistamines for symptom relief. Consult an allergist for persistent or severe symptoms.
